defs.def: unusually good 杰出的；优秀的；卓越的

ex.s: I often think of my exceptional roommate and of what a(n)  34  he was to me.
ex.t: 我常想起我出色的室友，以及他对于我是多么（34）的一个人。

ex.s: We will wander in traditional small towns and end our tour with an exceptional museum in Shanghai.
ex.t: 我们将在传统小镇中漫步，并以上海一座别具一格的博物馆结束行程。

ex.s: These advances have enabled people in various countries to benefit from exceptional innovations in crop production.
ex.t: 这些进步使各国人民能够受益于作物生产方面的卓越创新。

ex.s: In each place we went, we experienced wonderful local dishes, from Guangdong’s elegant dim sum—small servings of food in bamboo steamers—to the exceptional stewed noodles in Henan.
ex.t: 在我们去的每一个地方，我们都品尝到了美妙的当地菜肴，从广东精致的点心——放在竹蒸笼里的小份食物——到河南独特的烩面。

ex.s: When the train arrived at the station, they took a taxi to Lake Louise, where the blue water literally took their breath away with its exceptional beauty.
ex.t: 火车到站后，他们打车去了露易丝湖，那里碧蓝的湖水美得令人窒息，无与伦比。

defs.def: very unusual 异常的；特别的；罕见的

ex.s: When he was 16, he tried to enter university in Switzerland, but failed due to his low scores in the general part of the entrance exam, despite obtaining exceptional scores in maths and physics.
ex.t: 16 岁时，他试图考入瑞士的大学，但因入学考试通识部分的成绩不理想而失败，尽管他在数学和物理方面取得了异常优异的成绩。

ex.s: When something is contradictory to their view, they don’t treat it as exceptional.
ex.t: 当某事与他们的观点相矛盾时，他们不会将其视为例外。

ex.s: Caused by exceptionally heavy snowfall within a short period of time, they destroyed buildings and forest, and claimed over 256 lives.
ex.t: 由于在短时间内降下异常大雪，他们摧毁了建筑物和森林，夺去了256人的生命。
